continuedAt="f-1662-2"><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Management Agreement</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;text-align:justify"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The Company is externally managed and advised by the Manager pursuant to the terms of a management agreement between the Company and the Manager (as amended, the &#8220;Management Agreement&#8221;). Pursuant to the Management Agreement, the Company pays the Manager a base management fee equal to the greater of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="usd" contextRef="c-418" decimals="-3" name="trtx:ManagementFeePayablePerAnnum" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" scale="0" id="f-1663">250,000</ix:nonFraction> per annum ($<ix:nonFraction unitRef="usd" contextRef="c-418" decimals="-2" name="trtx:ManagementFeePayablePerQuarter" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" scale="0" id="f-1664">62,500</ix:nonFraction> per quarter) or <ix:nonFraction unitRef="number" contextRef="c-419" decimals="4" name="trtx:PercentageOfManagementFeeOnStockholdersEquity" scale="-2" id="f-1665">1.50</ix:nonFraction>% per annum (<ix:nonFraction unitRef="number" contextRef="c-419" decimals="5" name="trtx:PercentageOfManagementFeeOnStockholdersEquityPerQuarter" scale="-2" id="f-1666">0.375</ix:nonFraction>% per quarter) of the Company&#8217;s &#8220;Equity&#8221; as defined in the Management Agreement. Net proceeds from the issuance of Series B and Series C Preferred Stock are included in the Company&#8217;s Equity for purposes of determining the base management fee using the same daily weighted average method as is utilized for common equity. The base management fee is payable in cash, quarterly in arrears. The Manager is also entitled to incentive compensation which is calculated and payable in cash with respect to each calendar quarter in arrears in an amount, not less than zero, equal to the difference between: (1) the product of (a) <ix:nonFraction unitRef="number" contextRef="c-420" decimals="2" name="trtx:IncentiveManagementFeePercentageOfCoreEarningsLessSevenPercentOfStockholdersEquity" scale="-2" id="f-1667">20</ix:nonFraction>% and (b) the difference between (i) the Company&#8217;s Core Earnings for the most recent <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c-421" name="trtx:RelatedPartyTransactionPeriod" format="ixt-sec:durmonth" id="f-1668">12</ix:nonNumeric>-month period, including the calendar quarter (or part thereof) for which the calculation of incentive compensation is being made (the &#8220;applicable period&#8221;), and (ii) the product of (a) the Company&#8217;s Equity in the most recent <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c-422" name="trtx:RelatedPartyTransactionPeriod" format="ixt-sec:durmonth" id="f-1669">12</ix:nonNumeric>-month period, including the applicable period, and (b) <ix:nonFraction unitRef="number" contextRef="c-419" decimals="2" name="trtx:PercentageMultipliedByStockholdersEquityIncludedInIncentiveManagementFee" scale="-2" id="f-1670">7</ix:nonFraction>% per annum; and (2) the sum of any incentive compensation paid to the Manager with respect to the first <ix:nonFraction unitRef="calendarquarter" contextRef="c-423" decimals="0" name="trtx:RelatedPartyTransactionNumberOfCalendarQuarters" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" scale="0" id="f-1671">three</ix:nonFraction> calendar quarters of the most recent <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c-423" name="trtx:RelatedPartyTransactionPeriod" format="ixt-sec:durmonth" id="f-1672">12</ix:nonNumeric>-month period. No incentive compensation is payable to the Manager with respect to any calendar quarter unless Core Earnings for the <ix:nonFraction unitRef="calendarquarter" contextRef="c-421" decimals="0" name="trtx:RelatedPartyTransactionNumberOfCalendarQuarters" scale="0" id="f-1673">12</ix:nonFraction> most recently completed calendar quarters is greater than zero. For purposes of calculating the Manager&#8217;s incentive compensation, the Management Agreement specifies that equity securities of the Company or any of the Company&#8217;s subsidiaries that are entitled to a specified periodic distribution or have other debt characteristics will not constitute equity securities and will not be included in &#8220;Equity&#8221; for the purpose of calculating incentive compensation. Instead, the aggregate distribution amount that accrues to such equity securities during the calendar quarter of such calculation will be subtracted from Core Earnings, before incentive compensation for purposes of calculating incentive compensation, unless such distribution is otherwise excluded from Core Earnings.</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt;text-align:justify"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Core Earnings, as defined in the Management Agreement, means the net income (loss) attributable to the holders of the Company&#8217;s common stock and, without duplication, the holders of the Company&#8217;s subsidiaries&#8217; equity securities (other than the Company or any of the Company&#8217;s subsidiaries), computed in accordance with GAAP, including realized gains and losses not otherwise included in net income (loss), and excluding (i) non-cash equity compensation expense, (ii) the incentive compensation, (iii) depreciation and amortization, (iv) any unrealized gains or losses, including an allowance for credit losses, or other similar non-cash items that are included in net income for the applicable period, regardless of whether such items are included in other comprehensive income or loss or in net income and (v) one-time events pursuant to changes in GAAP and certain material non-cash income or expense items, in each case after discussions between the Manager and the Company&#8217;s independent directors and approved by a majority of the Company&#8217;s independent directors.</span></div></ix:continuation><div style="height:22.32pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div The two-class method is an allocation formula that determines earnings per share for each share of common stock and participating securities according to dividends declared and participation rights in undistributed earnings. Under this method, all earnings (distributed and undistributed) are allocated to common shares and participating securities based on their respective rights to receive dividends. The unvested restricted shares of the Company's common stock granted to certain current and former employees of affiliates of the Manager and affiliates of the Manager qualify as participating securities. These restricted shares have the same rights as the Company&#8217;s other shares of common stock, including participating in any dividends, and therefore are included in the Company&#8217;s basic and diluted earnings per share calculation. The Company establishes an accrued liability for loss contingencies when a settlement arising from a legal proceeding is both probable and reasonably estimable. If a legal matter is not probable and reasonably estimable, no such liability is recorded. Examples of this include (i) early stages of a legal proceeding, (ii) damages that are unspecified or cannot be determined, (iii) discovery has not started or is incomplete or (iv) there is uncertainty as to the outcome of pending appeals or motions.
